discrepancies.detail: PUT /api/streams/{name} sends is_deleted:false ("undelete") but handle_put_stream never reads is_deleted; the field is silently ignored.

Edit modal reads stream.detection_zones from GET /api/streams/{name}/full but the handler never emits it; zones come only from GET /api/streams/{name}/zones (StreamConfigModal.jsx:336). Comment on handle_get_stream_full ("also returns motion recording config") is stale: response is {stream:{...}} only.

StreamCard reads stream.error_message and the playback transport, but the admin summary (surface=admin) emits neither error_message nor playback_transport (playback_transport only on surface=live). Card tooltip/transport label silently fall back.

StreamsView always queries GET /api/detection/models; handler returns 403 for principals with no camera_configure grant (e.g. viewers). Contract must model 403 for this option dependency; UI tolerates it by showing no models.

Edit/delete gating mixes legacy role names from /api/auth/verify (admin/user/viewer) with per-camera summary can_configure; server authority is AUTHZ_CAMERA_CONFIGURE per camera. Edit-modal credential hiding uses /full can_control_privacy (== configure decision) as proxy.
/api/client-config returns snake_case only; index-page reads camelCase first (dead branches).

Router is first-match in registration order with method filter, "#" = one possibly-empty run of non-"/" characters, "*" = rest. Unmatched paths fall to static file resolution (returns 404 JSON for unknown /api/* paths rather than 405 for wrong method). Entire /go2rtc and /go2rtc/* namespace is diverted to the proxy thread regardless of method/registration (only 7 go2rtc patterns are registered; the proxy authorizer enforces its own allow-list).

Stream names are path segments matched before decoding; names containing "/" must be percent-encoded and decoded by http_request_extract_path_param. /full handler trims everything after first "/" of decoded id. Contract tests should include encoded names (T11).
Toast.jsx (ToastProvider/useToast) is unreferenced; duplicate toast API with ToastContainer.jsx.
Project 'go2rtc' testMatch /.*\.go2rtc\.spec\.ts/ matches no file; tests/integration/go2rtc.api.spec.ts runs in the 'api' project (npm run test:go2rtc relies on --grep @go2rtc instead).

contract_notes_for_T11: Viewer model must allow empty-string sensitive fields and must not require onvif_password/admin_url/sub_stream_url/detection_url/publish_url/go2rtc_source_override to be non-empty; admin model is distinguished by can_control_privacy=true (per-camera configure), not by role name.
detection_threshold is an integer percent on the wire (server stores float 0..1).
recording_schedule and detection_recording_schedule are fixed-length 168-element boolean arrays (hour-of-week).
retention_days and detection_retention_days range -1..365 (-1 = inherit/global). Tier multipliers are floats; storage_priority 1..10 is clamped client-side only.
protocol is numeric (0 TCP, 1 UDP); priority numeric; UI keeps them as strings in form state.
PUT returns 202 (async apply) except set_privacy_mode (200). GET /full wraps in {stream}; GET /{name} is unwrapped.
Stream name is the path key; must be percent-encoded (UI uses encodeURIComponent). Decoding happens in http_request_extract_path_param after routing.
Error envelope is {"error": "<message>"} (http_response_set_json_error, src/web/request_response.c:282) for all statuses.
openEditStreamModal uses raw fetch for /full (no 401 redirect handling, no timeout) while the list uses fetchJSON via useQuery.
